freshness.policy: Hand-refetched with npm run fetch:debt. Warn at 90 days: the World Bank refreshes IDS annually with the IDR release and in December and April as needed, so a 90-day-old snapshot has likely missed a refresh window. Fail at 365 days: past one annual cycle the snapshot is at least one release behind and the build refuses to ship it as current.
